acceptance_criteria.criterion: Default-OFF no-op: with CxapiSend disabled OR the tenant not allowlisted, NO row is ever stamped send_route='wapcrm_cxapi' and the ENTIRE send path (RateLimiter tenant-only key, MainAppCallbackClient bridge, ResetSendingMessages, broadcast counters/completion) behaves byte-for-byte as before. The RateLimiter int->(tenant,instance) key change maps the bridge to (tenant,0) which is semantically identical; the additive IsBroadcastComplete +'posting' and IncrementBroadcastCounter +'ambiguous' edits never match bridge rows.

Immutable route at create: for a cxapi-allowlisted tenant, BroadcastOrchestrator stamps send_route='wapcrm_cxapi' + message_kind='plain_text' + the tenant-default instance_id (settings_json->'wapcrm'.instance_id) onto outbound_broadcasts AND every outbound_messages row at create time. If the tenant is allowlisted but lacks instance_id/secret_key/user_id, the broadcast is REJECTED at create (INV-OB-062) with NO silent bridge fallback.

Sender route branch: MessageSenderService routes send_route='wapcrm_cxapi' rows through WapCrmSendClient.SendPlainTextAsync (instance_id from the row; secret+userId batch-loaded once per dequeue cycle for the distinct cxapi tenants via a single GetWapCrmSettingsBatchAsync query — no N+1, secret never logged/persisted); send_route='mainapp_bridge' rows keep the existing MainAppCallbackClient path unchanged. The cxapi rate-limit gate uses TryAcquire(tenant,instance); the bridge keeps TryAcquire(tenant).

Idempotent CAS state machine (no duplicate sends): SetMessagePostingAsync is a compare-and-swap UPDATE ... SET status='posting',attempt_count=@n,last_attempt_at=NOW() WHERE id=@id AND status='sending' (CancellationToken.None); the caller ABORTS the POST when 0 rows change. A message is NEVER POSTed while merely 'sending' (mandatory contract). A crash mid-'posting' leaves 'posting' (ResetSendingMessagesAsync only touches 'sending'); a startup stale-TTL sweep (last_attempt_at < NOW()-interval) resolves 'posting'->'ambiguous'. MarkCxapiOutcomeAsync is also a CAS (WHERE status='posting'), so a late POST return cannot resurrect a swept row. Outcome map (CxapiOutcomeMapper): Submitted->'sent'; ProviderFailed->'failed'; RateLimited && attempt<MaxSendAttempts -> 'queued' + (tenant,instance) cooldown; RateLimited && attempt>=max -> 'failed'; Ambiguous(timeout)/TransportError -> 'ambiguous' (NEVER auto-retried). Only RateLimited (provably not sent) is ever retried.

Structured provider persistence: every cxapi outcome writes provider_status_code / provider_status / provider_request_id / provider_error_message / last_attempt_at / attempt_count to the message row (WapCrmSendResult fields map 1:1 to the PR-1 columns). HTTP 200 + status=false is persisted as 'failed' with the provider code, never 'sent'. provider_request_id is audit-only (no lookup/matching until PR-3b).

DMP HARD FAIL on cxapi: a cxapi-routed broadcast whose template would use INMA DynamicMessage (useDynamic) is REJECTED at create (INV-OB-063) with NO silent bridge fallback; a per-message guard skips+warns any cxapi-bound text still containing '{{' after rendering. INSE static substitution (TemplateEngine.Substitute -> fully rendered static text) remains allowed. Historical DMP usage scanned read-only before allowlisting (prod scan 2026-06-06: 1 tenant enable_dynamic_message=TRUE, 0 DMP messages ever).

Counter + completion consistency: outbound_broadcasts gains an 'ambiguous' counter column; IncrementBroadcastCounterAsync whitelist+queued-decrement include 'ambiguous' so sent+failed+ambiguous+delivered+read+queued = total_recipients and queued reaches 0. IsBroadcastCompleteAsync adds 'posting' to the not-complete set (status IN ('queued','sending','posting')) so a broadcast is NEVER marked complete mid-POST; 'ambiguous' is terminal (does not block completion). The bulk-job AggregateBroadcastStatusAsync is broadcast.status-based (completed/failed) and is unaffected; the agg's display sum optionally adds ambiguous. A broadcast never strands in 'processing' nor completes prematurely.

Migration 056 additive + idempotent: (a) widens chk_message_status to add 'posting'+'ambiguous' (DROP-then-ADD); (b) ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS outbound_broadcasts.ambiguous INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 + CHECK (ambiguous >= 0); (c) DO $verify$ INV-SEED-056 fails loud if the new status values or column are absent; (d) syncs canonical arch/db/outbound.sql. No ext_id index, no bulk_send_jobs columns, no approved-template. INV-OB-062..065 registered in ErrorCodes.cs + errors.md. Full solution builds clean; CxapiSendStateMachineTests (mapper branches + RateLimiter cooldown) pass.

Atomic stranded-posting sweep: SweepStrandedPostingAsync is a SINGLE transactional CTE (UPDATE outbound_messages SET status='ambiguous' WHERE status='posting' AND send_route='wapcrm_cxapi' AND last_attempt_at < NOW()-interval RETURNING id,broadcast_id; then UPDATE outbound_broadcasts SET ambiguous=ambiguous+cnt, queued=GREATEST(queued-cnt,0) FROM the grouped returned rows) so a mid-sweep crash can never leave terminal messages with non-terminal counters; completion is attempted for the returned broadcast_ids and is idempotent. A route-scoped startup reset (cxapi 'sending'->'queued', pre-POST safe) runs before arming the timer; the bridge 'sending' rows are NOT touched.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: PR-3a ONLY — ext_id (composite UNIQUE (tenant_id, external_message_id) + tenant-scoped FindMessageByExternalIdAsync + delivery-status webhook tenant_id wiring) is deferred to PR-3b. This PR touches NONE of: idx_outbound_messages_external_id, FindMessageByExternalIdAsync, /api/v1/webhook/delivery-status. provider_request_id is persisted for audit only.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: G12 (cxapi requestID == delivery-status webhook id?) is OPEN (Q interview). The delivery-status webhook is tenant-blind AND carries no tenant_id; tightening ext_id while the lookup stays tenant-blind formalizes a cross-tenant ambiguity (Codex CQ9/Q2, the same finding that deferred it from PR-1). PR-3a writes NO external_message_id for cxapi rows, so it adds ZERO entries to the tenant-blind match space and cannot worsen the pre-existing posture; the webhook has NO fallback match (verified: it only UPDATEs by an existing external_message_id, never inserts). The residual risk is purely an ID-namespace collision between a cxapi callback and a bridge external_message_id.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: NO ext_id / FindMessageByExternalIdAsync / delivery-status-webhook change here. LIVE-ENABLEMENT GATE (operational, NOT code): no tenant is allowlisted for live cxapi sends until PR-3b lands OR cxapi/WapCRM delivery callbacks are proven NOT routed to /api/v1/webhook/delivery-status. Dark/default-OFF code is safe to ship now; codex_consult confirmed this split is correct.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Instance from the TENANT DEFAULT settings_json->'wapcrm'.instance_id (new nullable field on WapCrmSettings), resolved at broadcast-create and stamped IMMUTABLY onto outbound_broadcasts + every outbound_messages row. Secret + userId are batch-loaded at SEND (one query per dequeue cycle for the distinct cxapi tenants) and never persisted.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: bulk_send_jobs.instance_id is PR-4, so a job-carried instance can't survive preview->confirm in PR-3. A tenant-default instance needs no job column, covers CSV/list bulk-send-jobs AND direct broadcasts uniformly, and is immutable/auditable on the row. instance_id is taken from the SAME tenant's own settings, so instance ownership holds by construction (no GET /api/Instances probe).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: cross-tenant instance use impossible by construction (row instance_id = that tenant's own settings default). Secret/userId loaded per-batch at send, never written to any row/log/appsettings. WapCrmSettings += instance_id is a Shared change -> full solution build is intentional; the DTO is reused (no duplicate).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: State machine MINIMAL-BLAST: only NEW status strings are 'posting' (in-flight, external side effect may have happened) and 'ambiguous' (delivery unknown). Submitted->existing 'sent'; ProviderFailed + rate-limit-exhausted->existing 'failed'. cxapi detail lives in provider_* columns. outbound_broadcasts gains an 'ambiguous' counter so totals reconcile (sent+failed+ambiguous+delivered+read+queued = total_recipients).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q interview (minimal-blast) + Codex P1-3. Reusing 'sent'/'failed' keeps the delivery-status webhook and broadcast completion working; the ambiguous counter prevents the 'missing messages' totals gap the minimal model would otherwise create. Status contract: queued/sending/posting = non-terminal; sent/delivered/read/failed/ambiguous = terminal.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: 'submitted'/'provider_failed'/'leased' are deliberately NOT separate status strings. IsBroadcastCompleteAsync MUST gain 'posting' (else premature completion mid-POST); 'ambiguous' is terminal there. AggregateBroadcastStatusAsync is broadcast.status-based (completed/failed) -> unaffected by the new message statuses (verified). ExportRepository status CASEs degrade gracefully (out of scope).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Idempotency via COMPARE-AND-SWAP + ATOMIC sweep (Codex P0-1/P0-2/P1-1/P1-2). SetMessagePostingAsync = UPDATE ... SET status='posting' WHERE id=@id AND status='sending' (CancellationToken.None); caller ABORTS the POST on 0 rows. MarkCxapiOutcomeAsync = UPDATE ... WHERE id=@id AND status='posting' (0 rows -> swept/raced, skip counter). NEVER POST from 'sending'. ResetSendingMessagesAsync unchanged (only 'sending'). Startup: (1) route-scoped cxapi 'sending'->'queued' (pre-POST safe), (2) stale-TTL 'posting'->'ambiguous' sweep as a SINGLE atomic CTE updating messages + broadcast counters together. Only RateLimited (301/302, provably not sent) is requeued (to 'queued' + (tenant,instance) cooldown) up to MaxSendAttempts then 'failed'; Timeout->Ambiguous and TransportError both -> 'ambiguous' (NEVER auto-retried).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: A timeout/transport failure may have reached the server, so auto-retry risks an irreversible duplicate WhatsApp message; only 301/302 is provably not sent. CAS closes the StopAsync-reset race (a reset 'sending'->'queued' makes the posting CAS fail -> no POST) and prevents resurrection of swept rows. The atomic CTE sweep prevents a mid-sweep crash from leaving terminal messages with non-terminal counters. NSSM enforces single-instance; TTL+CAS is belt-and-suspenders.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: every cxapi POST is preceded by the posting CAS; there is NO fast path that POSTs from 'sending'. Crash-after-posting-before-POST yields a false-'ambiguous' (lost send, not a duplicate) — accepted (duplicates are the irreversible failure). 'ambiguous' rows are manual/ops, never auto-retried.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: RateLimiter gains a (tenant_id, instance_id) key + ApplyCooldown(tenant, instance, RetryAfter); the bridge keeps TryAcquire(tenantId) unchanged (mapped to instance 0). cxapi calls TryAcquire(tenant, instance); a RateLimited result applies a cooldown so subsequent dequeues for that instance back off (requeue-and-move-on, matching the existing bridge requeue pattern).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Codex P0 #6: rate limits are per WapCRM instance. The live tenant-only limiter must not change behavior (no-op guarantee). Cooldown-driven requeue reuses the exact existing 'TryAcquire fail -> requeue to queued -> retry next cycle' flow.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: TryAcquire(int) overload preserved (bridge -> (tenant,0)); composite key + cooldown additive. Pilot-scale head-of-line note: a cooled-down instance's rows are requeued and the loop moves on within the batch; sustained cooldown could delay rows behind them, acceptable at pilot scale with short Retry-After cooldowns (a future instance-aware dequeue is out of scope).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: DMP HARD-FAILED on the cxapi route: a cxapi-routed broadcast whose template would use INMA DynamicMessage (useDynamic) is rejected at create (INV-OB-063, no silent bridge fallback); a defensive per-message check skips any cxapi text still containing '{{'. INSE static substitution is still permitted (it renders to static text).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Codex P0 #3: cxapi plain-text has no DMP mechanism; silently routing a DMP broadcast to the bridge would surprise the operator. Historical DMP usage scanned read-only before allowlisting.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: the reject targets the INMA DynamicMessage path (useDynamic). Recipient-level INSE substitution that renders to static text is allowed; a leftover '{{' on a cxapi message is a guard, not normal flow. Prod scan: the 1 DMP-enabled tenant has 0 DMP messages ever.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Per-request secret reuse of the PR-2 WapCrmSendClient (TryAddWithoutValidation('X-CIB-SecretKey'), never DefaultRequestHeaders). Outbound adds a BATCH credential loader: SELECT settings_json->'wapcrm' FROM tenant_registry WHERE tenant_id = ANY(@ids) — one query for all distinct cxapi tenants in a dequeue batch.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Codex P0 #1/#8: a pooled HttpClient serving many tenants must attach the secret per request; per-message cred loads are an N+1. The opt-out client's DefaultRequestHeaders pattern is intentionally NOT reused.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: WapCrmSettings DTO reused (no duplicate); the batch loader queries tenant_registry (same shared Postgres). Secret never logged/persisted/in-appsettings.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Migration 056 claims the next sequential number (055 was PR-1). PKT-2's projects migration shifts 056->057 (roadmap updated). 056 = chk_message_status widen + outbound_broadcasts.ambiguous column + INV-SEED-056 + canonical outbound.sql sync.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: outbound_messages.status has chk_message_status CHECK; the new 'posting'/'ambiguous' values would violate it, so a migration is required even though G12 deferred ext_id. The ambiguous counter is required for totals reconciliation (Codex P1-3).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CHECK-widen + one additive counter column only; no ext_id unique index, no bulk_send_jobs columns. Both edits (056 + outbound.sql) stay in sync (CQ11).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Feature flag CxapiSendOptions (Enabled default false + AllowedTenantIds + MaxSendAttempts + DefaultCooldownMs + StalePostingMinutes + IsTenantAllowed) mirrors BulkSendOptions; default OFF + empty allowlist => zero behavioral change in production.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: HIGH-risk live send-path change needs a gradual, reversible cutover (BulkSend precedent) + the P0-3 live-enablement gate.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: with the flag off / no tenant allowlisted, no row is ever send_route='wapcrm_cxapi', so the whole PR is inert in prod until Q opts a tenant in (subject to the P0-3 gate).

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every cxapi outcome resolves to an explicit persisted status + provider_* columns via a CAS write (Submitted->sent, ProviderFailed->failed, RateLimited->queued+cooldown or failed, Ambiguous/TransportError->ambiguous) and a structured [cxapi-send] log line; the stranded-posting sweep is an atomic CTE so no half-state survives a crash. The deliberate 'do-nothing-further' states are RateLimited-requeue (explicit cooldown, retried) and 'ambiguous' (explicit, manual/ops, NOT auto-retried to avoid duplicate sends) — both loud, not swallowed. A CAS that affects 0 rows aborts the POST or skips the counter (logged), preventing duplicate sends/double counters rather than silently proceeding. DMP/misconfig are hard rejects with codes, never silent bridge fallback. Secret intentionally absent from logs. Default-OFF -> none of this runs in prod until Q allowlists a tenant.
